newsitem.title: JAPAN: Debenture-issuing firms do not need help - Japan MOF.
newsitem.headline: Debenture-issuing firms do not need help - Japan MOF.

text.p: Japanese financial institutions issuing bank debentures do not need support from the authorities at the moment, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Monday.

"There is no need to give support at the moment," Mitsuzuka said in a reply to a question by an opposition party official on whether the government has any intention of using public funds to help investors if banks fail to honour debentures.
Mitsuzuka said that debenture-issuing banks were doing their utmost to boost profits by taking steps such as restructuring.
"I"ve received reports from each one of them and they are all doing their best. There are no such worries," Mitsuzuka said.
